messages:
sophia: Flagging a metering discrepancy on INV-21890 for customer LumenMaps. Our export shows ~3.7k extra embeds compared to the customer's SDK logs. Suspect vendor proxy byte-shift bug. @omar @rachel

omar: Noted. Which vendor and window? Any sample request_ids?

sophia: Vendor=edge-proxy-intl, window=2027-06-02T02:20:00Z..2027-06-02T02:50:00Z. Sample IDs: lm-req-7f1a, lm-req-7f1b. billing-bot also flagged anomaly.

vendor-proxy-bot: ALERT: embed_count_mismatch | vendor=edge-proxy-intl | customer=lumenmaps-11 | window=2027-06-02T02:20..02:50Z | delta=3721 | severity=high

rachel: Quick hypothesis: we saw a recent change in proxy buffering where multi-part payloads were concatenated without proper boundary markers. If the ingest decoder treats the shifted boundary as separate requests, it could create phantom embed rows. I'll fetch raw payloads.

omar: Run a fingerprint diff on raw payloads vs billing rows. Example query:
```
SELECT r.raw_id, r.raw_bytes_hash, b.request_id, b.payload_hash
FROM embeds.raw_inserts r
LEFT JOIN billing.embed_rows b ON r.raw_id = b.raw_id
WHERE r.customer_id='lumenmaps-11' AND r.inserted_at BETWEEN '2027-06-02T02:20:00Z' AND '2027-06-02T02:50:00Z'
LIMIT 200;
```

rachel: Pulled sample -> /tmp/lumen-proxy-samples.ndjson. Seeing repeated raw_bytes_hash with two billing rows each but different request_id; suggests boundary shift produced two parse events.

sophia: Finance estimate: 3721 phantom embeds * $0.19 = $707.99 -> round provisional credit $710. Need approval to apply provisional credit to INV-21890 pending reconciliation.

omar: Ops action: (1) targeted backfill to mark phantom billing rows non-billable, (2) vendor ticket to edge-proxy-intl asking them to revert buffering change, (3) verification. ETA for backfill 2-3 hrs.

andy-cs: CS requests provisional credit applied immediately; customer is on a call. Suggested message: "We applied a provisional credit while we investigate a vendor-side parsing issue; we'll follow up with the reconciliation."

sophia: I approve provisional credit up to $725 to expedite customer comms. Please create billing_journal entry with reason="vendor parse boundary - provisional credit" and tag invoice INV-21890.

rachel: Opening vendor ticket VND-8801 with edge-proxy-intl and attaching sample ndjson. Also starting backfill job backfill-7722. Will post job id and completion.

omar: Backfill started job backfill-7722 at 2027-06-02T03:05:12Z. Will post reconciled numbers after job completes.

vendor-proxy-bot: ACTION: create_vendor_ticket | id=VND-8801 | vendor=edge-proxy-intl | issue="buffer concat boundary shift" | severity=high

andy-cs: Notifying customer: "A provisional credit has been applied while we investigate. We'll send a detailed reconciliation when complete."

sophia: Finance: hold final ledger adjustment until reconciled diff is attached. Once backfill completes, please post the CSV and final delta here. :thumbsup:
